_note: Name-facts for Guatemala (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: The capital moved here after earthquakes destroyed Antigua Guatemala in 1773.
It is the largest city in Central America.
It lies in a highland valley at about 1,500 m.
it: La capitale fu spostata qui dopo che i terremoti distrussero Antigua Guatemala nel 1773.
È la città più grande dell’America centrale.
Si trova in una valle d’altopiano a circa 1.500 m.
de: Die Hauptstadt wurde hierher verlegt, nachdem Erdbeben 1773 Antigua Guatemala zerstört hatten.
Sie ist die größte Stadt Mittelamerikas.
Sie liegt in einem Hochlandtal auf etwa 1.500 m.

en: Its Nahuatl name means the walled place of the quetzal bird.
Its K'iche' name Xelajú is often shortened to Xela.
It served as the capital of the short-lived state of Los Altos.
it: Il suo nome nahuatl significa il luogo fortificato dell’uccello quetzal.
Il suo nome k’iche’ Xelajú viene spesso abbreviato in Xela.
Fu capitale dell’effimero Stato di Los Altos.
de: Ihr Nahuatl-Name bedeutet ummauerter Ort des Quetzalvogels.
Ihr K'iche'-Name Xelajú wird oft zu Xela verkürzt.
Sie war Hauptstadt des kurzlebigen Staates Los Altos.
